snippet.title: Toy Worlds Atlas: Trailer I
snippet.description:
🔗 Wishlist Toy Worlds Atlas on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4793230/Toy_Worlds_Atlas/

Toy Worlds Atlas is a colouring book game that explores philosophy through creative puzzle-solving. Each colouring page is a relaxing and reflective visual feast with a unique puzzle mechanic. Every new level gets curiouser and curiouser, more meta and meta-meta.

Living beings perceive reality differently. Minds toy with subjective pictures of reality. Toy Worlds Atlas imagines subjective worlds materialized, and invites you to decide how they would look like. The game is a playground that fosters thought, imagination and creativity through playful interactions.

Discover philosophical ideas transformed into colourful playthings, inspired by thinkers ranging from Heidegger and Deleuze to Dennett and Chalmers. Enhance your erudition and reflect on some of the deepest questions through short, playful, and intellectually satisfying puzzles.

A strong surreal art style inspired by the nostalgic visual language of 1990s illustrated encyclopedias and educational atlases.
